title: Dow Genius
description: Tune in to the Dow Genius, who teaches viewers about the stock market and predicts—often unsuccessfully—which stocks are the best investments.
quote: So, we had a down day in the market. Do we get scared? No! We go to Brazil where they are cornering the bird flu vaccine market.
altHero: the Dow Genius in his chaoticly decorated studio
alt1: Dow Genius cutting a big banner of a crying emoji face with giant scissors
alt2: Dow Genius hitting his head with a big mallet
alt3: Dow Genius on a call with Bill from Texas
alt4: Dow Genius hitting buttons to make colored spotlights show up
